==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{l|en|Web page}}, {{l|en|web-page}}, {{l|en|webpage}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|id=hypertext document|:af|Web|page<id:sheet of paper>}}
1994, {{compound|en|Web|page}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈwɛb ˌpeɪd͡ʒ/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-web page.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|Q36774}}{{lb|en|Internet}} A single [[hypertext]] document (transmitted as [[HTML]]) on the [[World Wide Web]], often [[hyperlink]]ed to others, and intended to be viewed with a [[web browser]].
#: {{hol|en|website}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=2007|author=Doug Rich|title=How to Search for Supernovae|journal=Astronomy|volume=35|number=3|month=March|pages=70–72
|passage=Dave Bishop, an amateur astronomer, operates a supernova '''web page''' at www.rochesterastronomy.org/supernova.html, which lists new discoveries, including images.}}
# {{lb|en|loosely}} A [[website]], by extension from the [[home page]] of the site.
#: {{ux|en|Be sure to check out my '''web page''' on the Internet when you get home.}}
